correctness.rationale: Exact metric distance cases force the full scale-two join identity. The complete-graph two-layer clique factor has homotopy of a bouquet of (a-1) circles. The scale-one two copies of the multipartite clique complex joined by N bridges yield the stated wedge. All persistence maps follow from degree separation; integral symmetry follows by directed matching-edge cycles and the torsion-free Kunneth join formula. Finite mod-two tests corroborate, not replace, the universal proof.
